modSubtitle: Hide harmful responses or merge duplicate statements.
modHelp: Hidden responses don't appear to anyone — not in voting, results, or analysis. Hiding is reversible. To merge duplicates, tap a duplicate statement and then the canonical one to keep. Votes are combined at analysis time and no data is deleted; merges and hides can be undone here.
modSelectDuplicate: Select a duplicate to merge, or hide a response.
modTapToKeep: Now tap the statement you want to keep.
modTapToMerge: Tap to start merging, or use the icon to hide.
